Rickshaw Riot, Book 1

By Ben Wolf, Luke Messa

  • Series: Rickshaw Riot
  • Narration: Ryan H. Reid
  • Featuring: Gary Furlong, Jeff Hays, Annie Ellicott, Rebecca Brokaw-Sands, Johnathan McClain
  • Length: 9 hours and 56 minutes

Video game mogul, Erik Shaw, is minutes away from becoming a billionaire. Once he launches his immersive digital playground, the AllVerse, countless gamers will dive headfirst into a world that combines every video game ever created. Then Erik will cash in on their subscription fees, and he’ll never have to play another video game again. But when Erik initiates the launch, a system-wide glitch traps him in the AllVerse, with over a billion gamers and a rogue AI that has seized control of the world. It’s the last place Erik wants to be, and he wants nothing more than to escape back to the real world, where he’s on top.

Rickshaw Riot is the first book in the rip-roaring Rickshaw Erik Shaw LitRPG series, co-written by Ben Wolf and Luke Messa. It’s perfect for fans of Dungeon Crawler Carl, Discount Dan, and He Who Fights with Monsters.
